description: Ten distinct Cape Town-inspired scenic route sections of varying length, each a self-contained scene, populated with alleys, pedestrians and parked cars. Replaces the 'one 100 km continuous route' and 'lap collecting' ideas with bounded, art-directed rides.

architecture.routeModel: Each section is a bounded closed route (like the current Camps Bay loop) with its own length, elevation profile, scenery theme and biome. No streaming of a 100 km world; sections are selected from a menu.
architecture.builder: Generalise CapeCrownSceneBuilder into a RouteSectionBuilder that emits a named scene per section from a declarative section definition (route geometry + theme + props).
architecture.life: A pooled population system (pedestrians, parked cars, moving cars) that spawns only near the rider and despawns with distance, so 10 populated sections never exceed a small active-object budget on iPad.
architecture.agent: An isolated OpenClaw subagent per section that runs the builder, captures Game-view screenshots, and iterates against a reference, reporting a Go/No-Go to the main chat.

userStories.title: Declarative route-section builder
userStories.description: As a builder I want each route section defined by data (route geometry, length, elevation, theme, prop set) so adding a new section is a definition, not new code.
acceptanceCriteria: A section definition produces a named scene via the existing menu/build path
Route geometry, placement and cyclist validations pass for every section
Each section keeps its own generated asset folder and scene file
Verified in Unity: build all 10 sections, no validation failures
userStories.notes: Generalise the current CapeCrownSceneBuilder; do not fork per section.

userStories.title: Life population system (pooled)
userStories.description: As a rider I want pedestrians, parked cars and street-level detail (alleys, crossings) so routes feel lived-in without costing performance.
acceptanceCriteria: Pedestrians walk along sidewalks and alleys; parked cars line the streets
Active objects are pooled and only exist near the rider (bounded budget on iPad)
Objects despawn smoothly with distance, no pop-in at the rider
Verified on device: stable frame time with a populated section
userStories.notes: Reuse Synty City/Generic characters and vehicles already in the project. Pedestrians and cars are cosmetic, no AI cost.

userStories.title: Route selection menu
userStories.description: As a rider I want to pick a route section from the start menu instead of one fixed scene.
acceptanceCriteria: Start menu lists unlocked sections with length and climb
Selecting a section loads its scene and starts the ride
Progress per section is remembered (not yet gated by story km)
userStories.notes: Story gating (races + km) is a later feature; selection UI first.

userStories.title: Section-build subagent (the 'agent')
userStories.description: As Vik I want an isolated agent that builds and visually verifies a section without burning main-chat tokens.
acceptanceCriteria: A subagent builds a specified section, captures Game-view screenshots from fixed viewpoints
It reports a Go/No-Go with evidence to the main chat
Main chat only reviews results, never re-explains the build
userStories.notes: Depends on SEC-001. The subagent orchestrates the builder; it does not invent art style.
